_comment: Edit this file to change your screening criteria. No code changes needed.
_source: Will Holt's actual underwriting model — calibrated from Mill One analysis

debt._comment_dscr: DSCR <1.20 = warning; <1.10 = hard NO-GO regardless of other metrics

income._comment_proforma: Flag if pro-forma NOI >15% above trailing — seller optimism

expenses._comment_tax: Flag if stated taxes <0.5% of asking price — likely pre-reassessment. Mill One: $24k stated vs $298k correct.
expenses._comment_assessment: NC norm: assessed at ~60% of purchase price post-sale
expenses._comment_rate: Guilford County rate — override for other markets

commercial._comment_concentration: Warn if commercial >40% of gross rent — requires lease-level modeling
commercial._comment_leases: Warn if all commercial leases expire within hold period — TI/downtime/commission risk
